entries.effect: CGRectNull, always. A device that does not support the rectangle has none to report, and CGRectNull is what the host's own camera answers here (measured) and what the header's own default-rectangle methods return in the same case (:1184). Nothing is kept per device: a setter that refuses every value cannot have a last accepted one, so there is no rectangle to store and no way to read one back. -setFocusRectOfInterest: refuses in the order Apple's own refuses, measured on this host - NSGenericException while the configuration lock is not held ('May not be called without first successfully gaining exclusive ownership of the device using -lockForConfiguration:', and the lock is read through the release's own -isLockedForConfiguration), then NSInvalidArgumentException '*** -[AVCaptureDevice setFocusRectOfInterest:] Not supported - use -isFocusRectOfInterestSupported'
